notes.title: Burial Stone 1.1.0 update.
notes.content:
After a few issues with my account.

I have addressed some issues with Burial Stone that have been there for a while.

First of all, recording with SteamVR suppose to work.

Also, some visual issues were fixed.

Overall I hope the experience will be better now.

There is going to be another update to the Demo build as well.

notes.title: Version 1.0.8, issues fixed, big internal overhaul.
notes.content:
Hi,

I have released version 1.0.8.

This version includes:

Smooth rotation, useful for non VR.
Better sized tooltips, in VR and non VR(please tell me if there are issues).
Brighter text on player character and options. Makes it easier to read.
Back button UI in in game menu. So you won't have to press key/gamepad, and can click with mouse(without having to restart).


There were some big changes internally, I had to rework some things.
Please let me know if there are any major issues.

I wish to add more content in the future, hope you will follow.

notes.title: Version 1.075 update
notes.content:
Action Bar UI now fits different resolutions.
Can change distance between left and right part of UI.

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
Drop Pit visual update.
Bigger V for attributes.
Some infrastructure changes, hopefully no new bugs introduced

notes.title: Big update, version 1.0.51
notes.content:
A lot of small things updated.
After some rework, so might introduce bugs. Please report any bug you find.

Improvements:
1. Magic Shield now has timeout.
2. Fire bolt now flies at target even when walks.
3. Stacking items.
4. Can now pass turn with left thumbstick(or secondary controller) press button.
5. Correctly showing melee damage weapon on character.

notes.title: Version 1.0.43 update
notes.content:
Left handed support.
Visual bug fixes.

notes.title: Burial Stone, 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
1. Blood appears correctly under UI.
2. Enemy health bars, facing players.
3. Morning Star held better in hand.
4. Left and right hands equally aligned.
5. Can exit outro.
